title: Ontario municipalities (census subdivisions) outside the 77 largest, with their upper tier and import coverage

source.table: Table 98-10-0002-01 Population and dwelling counts: Canada, provinces and territories, census divisions and census subdivisions (municipalities)
source.attribution: Source: Statistics Canada, Table 98-10-0002-01 Population and dwelling counts: Canada, provinces and territories, census divisions and census subdivisions (municipalities), 2021 Census of Population, retrieved 2026-11-17. Reproduced and distributed on an "as is" basis with the permission of Statistics Canada.
source.licence_note: Licence page read on 2026-11-16 by the lane that built ontario-municipalities-51-75.json; the same table and licence are used here.
source.metadata_file: 98100002_MetaData.csv (geographic attributes GEO_TYPE_ABBR, GEO_TYPE_DESC and parent census division)

boundaries.publisher: Province of Ontario, Land Information Ontario
boundaries.dataset: Municipal Boundary - Lower and Single Tier
boundaries.use: Used only to work out the upper tier (UPPER_TIER_MUNICIPALITY) and to count which imported records fall inside each municipality. The boundaries are not imported into data/.

method: Rows of 98100002.csv whose DGUID starts with 2021A000535 (census subdivisions in Ontario) were joined to the table's own metadata file for the census subdivision type and parent census division. Indian reserves (IRI), Indian settlements (S-É) and unorganized territories (NO) are not municipalities and are left out: 414 municipalities remain, which with Ontario's 30 upper-tier municipalities makes the province's 444. The 77 already listed in ontario-top-50-municipalities.json and ontario-municipalities-51-75.json are left out, leaving the municipalities below, sorted by 2021 population. upper_tier is the Land Information Ontario boundary's UPPER_TIER_MUNICIPALITY (null for a single-tier municipality, including every municipality in a territorial district and the separated cities and towns); the boundary was matched to the census subdivision by name within its census division. municipal_records counts, per source, the records of sources/registry.json entries of kind municipal whose point, or a path's first vertex, falls inside the municipality's boundary (generalized to 0.0001 degrees, about 10 m), counted on the branch that last changed this file. status is imported when that count is above zero, otherwise gap with the name of the sources/gaps.json record that says why, or pending while the sweep has not reached that publisher. Province-wide sources (OpenStreetMap, Statistics Canada, Province of Ontario) are not counted here.
